newsitem.title: ZAIRE: Zaire's Mobutu not due back home this week - aide.
newsitem.headline: Zaire's Mobutu not due back home this week - aide.

text.p: Zaire's President Mobutu Sese Seko will not be returning home from Europe this weekend despite his own earlier hint, his security aide said on Wednesday.

"The president will come back home some time soon. But no date has been set so far. At least, it's sure that he is not coming back to Zaire this weekend," security adviser Honore Ngbanda told Reuters.
Mobutu has been in Europe for more than three months, first for cancer surgery in Switzerland, and then for recuperation at his French Riviera villa.

Zaire has since been gripped by violence and a refugee crisis following a rebellion by Rwandan-backed ethnic Tutsis in two eastern provinces. The Zairean army has been routed in the region and more than a million Rwandan and Burundian Hutu camp refugees and Zairean villagers displaced.

Mobutu told a television interviewer earlier this month he wanted to get back home and take charge. He raised expectations for a homecoming this weekend by saying he would head for Zaire three days after a November 25 followup medical check.
Prime Minister Kengo wa Dondo, citing that interview, told a news conference last week that Mobutu was likely to return to Kinshasa by the end of the month.
"When the date is set for the return of the head of state, everyone will know," Ngbanda said.
